prompt: Create a full-length instrumental fantasy game soundtrack song for Oldwall: broken ancient walls among bracken and autumn woods above a quiet tarn. No vocals, singing, speech, chanting, or spoken words. This is song 1 of two for this land; make it distinct and complete.
